would.sentenceEn: Persuading studios to film here would become much more challenging if we couldn't offer a deep bench of local film workers, on-screen talent and local businesses that support the entertainment industry.
would.translationZh: 如果我们无法提供由本地影视从业人员、出镜人才以及支持娱乐产业的本地企业构成的深厚人才储备，那么说服制片厂来此拍摄将会变得更加困难。
would.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

would.sentenceEn: Sir John Reith said that it would end "isolation of the spirit" and rejoiced: "It does not matter how many thousands may be listening, there is always enough for others…the genius and the fool, the wealthy and the poor listen simultaneously."
would.translationZh: 约翰·里思爵士曾表示，这将终结“精神上的孤立”，并欣喜地说道：“无论成千上万的人如何倾听，总是能惠及他人……天才与愚夫、富人与穷人都在同一时刻倾听。”
would.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

would.sentenceEn: I loved the man from the Thirties research who found that wireless suddenly offered "a lot of variety…things I thought I 'd never be interested in…ice hockey perhaps".
would.translationZh: 我很喜欢那项三十年代研究中的那位受访者，他发现广播突然间提供了“极其丰富的内容……那些我原以为自己永远不会感兴趣的东西……比如冰球”。
would.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

would.sentenceEn: The NAFSN sites experienced less than a quarter of the number of fires that would have been expected without fire suppression.
would.translationZh: NAFSN 站点的火灾发生数量不到在没有灭火措施情况下预期火灾数量的四分之一。
would.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

would.sentenceEn: Ask people about public libraries and a certain image springs to mind: dusty, old-fashioned, the sort of place you enjoyed as a child but, rather like a British seaside town, would you go there now?
would.translationZh: 问起人们对公共图书馆的看法，脑海中总会浮现出某种特定画面：尘土飞扬、陈旧过时。就像那种你小时候很喜欢，但现在是否还会光顾的地方——某种程度上，就和英国的海滨小镇一样。
would.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

would.sentenceEn: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?
would.translationZh: 以下哪项最适合作为本文的标题？

writing.sentenceEn: We are living through a golden age of science writing , so lucid and accessible that even lay readers can relish the unpredictability of discovery.
writing.translationZh: 我们正生活在科普写作的黄金时代，这些作品清晰易懂，即便是外行读者也能领略科学发现中那不可预知的魅力。

writing.sentenceEn: O'Hanlon said she had been most surprised by the "emotional literacy that was evident in the [target] children's writing " and that they were "more resilient in their writing , more hopeful".
writing.translationZh: 奥汉隆表示，她最惊讶的是“[目标]儿童作品中展现出的情感认知能力”，以及他们“在写作中表现出更强的适应力和更积极的希望”。
writing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

writing.sentenceEn: A study found that a "rehearsal room" approach to teaching Shakespeare broadened children's vocabulary and the complexity of their writing as well as their emotional literacy.
writing.translationZh: 一项研究发现，采用"排练室"式的莎士比亚教学方法，不仅能拓宽儿童的词汇量，提升其写作的复杂性，还能增强他们的情感素养。
writing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

writing.sentenceEn: The Gutenberg printing press transformed civilisation not by changing the nature of writing but by changing its cost—and it would have achieved little without a parallel collapse in the price of surfaces to write on, thanks to an often-overlooked technology called paper.
writing.translationZh: 古腾堡印刷机改变了文明，并非通过改变书写的本质，而是通过改变其成本——如果没有另一种常被忽视的技术（即纸张）导致书写载体价格的同步暴跌，印刷机也难以取得多大成就。
writing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

writing.sentenceEn: For him, writing is a normal job—a job like any other.
writing.translationZh: 对他而言，写作就是一份普通的工作——和其他任何工作没什么两样。
writing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

writing.sentenceEn: The quality of writings is of primary importance.

web.sentenceEn: Ohio State University allowed its students to navigate the Oval, a lawn in the centre of campus, freely, then proceeded to pave the desire paths, creating a web of effective routes students had established.
web.translationZh: 俄亥俄州立大学允许学生们在校园中心的椭圆形草坪（the Oval）自由穿行，随后学校将这些学生们自然踩出的小径铺设成路，形成了一张由学生自行开辟的高效路线网络。
web.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

web.sentenceEn: And surfing the web exercised the brain more than reading did among computer-savvy older adults in a 2008 study involving 24 participants at the Semel Institute for Neuroscience and Human Behavior at the University of California, Los Angeles.
web.translationZh: 2008年，加州大学洛杉矶分校塞梅尔神经科学与人类行为研究所开展了一项涉及24名参与者的研究，结果显示，在精通电脑的老年人中，上网冲浪比阅读更能锻炼大脑。
web.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

web.sentenceEn: During the 2016 presidential campaign, nearly a quarter of web content shared by Twitter users in the politically critical state of Michigan was fake news, according to the University of Oxford.
web.translationZh: 牛津大学的研究显示，在2016年总统竞选期间，在政治关键州密歇根州，Twitter用户分享的网络内容中近四分之一是虚假新闻。
web.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

web.sentenceEn: What WhatsApp offered Facebook was an intricate and finely detailed web of its users' friendships and social lives.
web.translationZh: WhatsApp为Facebook提供的，是其用户的友谊和社交生活所构成的一个复杂而精细的网络。
web.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

web.sentenceEn: The web 's full of articles offering tips on making time to read: "Give up TV" or "Carry a book with you at all times."
web.translationZh: 网络上充斥着各种教人如何挤出时间阅读的文章：“放弃看电视”或“随时随身携带一本书”。
web.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

web.sentenceEn: But in some cases, one marketer's owned media become another marketer's paid media – for instance, when an e-commerce retailer sells ad space on its Web site.
web.translationZh: 但在某些情况下，一个营销者的自有媒体会成为另一个营销者的付费媒体——例如，当电子商务零售商在其网站上销售广告位时。
web.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

willing.sentenceEn: In addition, you need to be willing to stand up to scrutiny and criticism and be prepared to explain your innovation in different ways for various audiences.
willing.translationZh: 此外，你需要勇于接受审视和批评，并准备好以不同方式向不同受众解释你的创新。
willing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

willing.sentenceEn: The findings showed that help-seekers generally underestimate how willing other people will be to help and how good it'll make the help-giver feel (for most people, having the chance to help someone is highly rewarding ).
willing.translationZh: 研究结果显示，求助者通常会低估他人提供帮助的意愿，以及这会给帮助者带来的愉悦感（对大多数人来说，有机会帮助他人是一件非常有意义的事情）。
willing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

willing.sentenceEn: If customers are not willing to share data, AI will be starved of essential information and will not be able to function effectively or employ machine learning to improve its marketing content and communication.
willing.translationZh: 如果客户不愿意分享数据，人工智能将缺乏必要的信息，无法有效运作，也无法利用机器学习来改进其营销内容和沟通方式。
willing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

willing.sentenceEn: Some 81% of respondents said they would be willing to pay additional taxes for the next 10 years to avoid any cuts to the national parks.
willing.translationZh: 约81%的受访者表示，他们愿意在未来10年缴纳额外税款，以避免国家公园的任何经费削减。
willing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

willing.sentenceEn: An economic survey of 700 U.S. taxpayers found that people would be willing to pay a significant amount of money to make sure the parks and their programs are kept intact.
willing.translationZh: 一项针对700名美国纳税人的经济调查显示，人们愿意支付可观的金额，以确保国家公园及其各项项目保持原样。
willing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

willing.sentenceEn: Advertisers are willing to implement DNT.
willing.translationZh: 广告商愿意实施“不追踪”（DNT）机制。

widely.sentenceEn: Among the 10 worst performers were some of the most populous states, including Texas, which was given the lowest grade (F) and has a disproportionate influence because its textbooks are widely sold elsewhere.
widely.translationZh: 在表现最差的10个州中，不乏一些人口最多的州，其中包括得克萨斯州——该州被评为最低等级（F级），但其影响力却不成比例地大，因为该州的教科书在其他地区也有广泛销售。
widely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

widely.sentenceEn: Another issue is that while climate change is well integrated into some subjects and at some ages—such as earth and space sciences in high schools—it is not as well represented in curricula for younger children and in subjects that are more widely taught, such as biology and chemistry.
widely.translationZh: 另一个问题是，虽然气候变化已很好地融入某些学科和特定年龄段的教学中——例如高中的地球与空间科学——但在低龄儿童的课程以及生物、化学等开设更为普遍的学科中，气候变化的内容却未能得到同等程度的体现。
widely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

widely.sentenceEn: Any writer needs to read as much and as widely as they can; it's the one indispensable supporter—something you can't do without.
widely.translationZh: 任何作家都需要尽可能多地广泛阅读；阅读是不可或缺的支撑——是写作过程中万万不能缺少的要素。
widely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

widely.sentenceEn: Though widely prevalent, the concept of dark patterns is still not well understood.
widely.translationZh: 尽管暗模式的应用极为普遍，但其概念至今仍未被充分理解。
widely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

widely.sentenceEn: Look up Homo sapiens in the "Red List" of threatened species of the International Union for the Conservation of Nature (IUCN) and you will read: "Listed as Least Concern as the species is very widely distributed, adaptable, currently increasing, and there are no major threats resulting in an overall population decline."
widely.translationZh: 在国际自然保护联盟（IUCN）的濒危物种《红色名录》中查阅“智人”，你会看到：“被列为无危物种，因为该物种分布极为广泛，适应性强，目前数量正在增加，且不存在导致整体种群数量下降的主要威胁。”
widely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

widely.translationZh: 机械设备得到了广泛应用。

workforce.sentenceEn: As demand for healthcare continues to grow, pressures on the workforce —which is already near breaking point—will only become more acute.
workforce.translationZh: 随着医疗保健需求的持续增长，本已濒临极限的劳动力所面临的压力只会愈发严峻。
workforce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

workforce.sentenceEn: "We are at a crisis level on the supply of rental housing," said Nick Taylor, executive director of the Workforce Housing Coalition of the Greater Seacoast.
workforce.translationZh: “我们的出租住房供应已处于危机水平，”大海岸地区劳动力住房联盟执行董事尼克·泰勒说道。
workforce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

workforce.sentenceEn: Older Americans are also the fastest-growing segment of the US workforce , and boomers are expected to live longer than previous generations.
workforce.translationZh: 美国老年人群体也是美国劳动力中增长最快的部分，而婴儿潮一代预计将比前几代人更长寿。
workforce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

workforce.sentenceEn: More Americans are opting to work well into retirement, a growing trend that threatens to upend the old workforce model.
workforce.translationZh: 越来越多的美国人选择在退休后继续工作，这一日益增长的趋势可能会颠覆旧有的劳动力模式。
workforce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

workforce.sentenceEn: About 20% of people 65 and older were in the workforce in February, up from an all-time low of 10% in January 1985, according to money manager United Income.
workforce.translationZh: 资产管理公司联合收入（United Income）的数据显示，今年2月，65岁及以上人群中约有20%仍在劳动力市场，而这一比例在1985年1月曾降至10%的历史最低水平。
workforce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第6句

workforce.translationZh: 其员工队伍需要接受更多培训。

wrong.sentenceEn: Instead of saying what is wrong , broken, or suboptimal, talk about what is right, fixable, or ideal.
wrong.translationZh: 与其谈论问题、不足或不够理想之处，不如多说说积极面、可改进的地方或理想状态。
wrong.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第2句

wrong.sentenceEn: And firms pay staff less because firms carry the burden of the employment arrangement going wrong .
wrong.translationZh: 而且企业会降低员工薪酬，因为企业要承担雇佣安排出现问题时的风险。
wrong.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

wrong.sentenceEn: "It's like baking a cake: If you don't have exact amounts, it goes wrong ," she says.
wrong.translationZh: 她说：“这就像烤蛋糕一样：如果用料比例不准确，就会出问题。”
wrong.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

wrong.sentenceEn: On the other hand, putting your faith in the wrong place often carries a high price.
wrong.translationZh: 另一方面，错信他人往往会付出高昂的代价。
wrong.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

wrong.sentenceEn: While the researchers assumed that the well-structured daily plans would be most effective when it came to the execution of tasks, they were wrong : the detailed daily plans demotivated students.
wrong.translationZh: 尽管研究人员认为，在执行任务时，结构完善的每日计划会最为有效，但他们错了：详细的每日计划反而打击了学生的积极性。
wrong.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

wrong.sentenceEn: It has been available even in the most mundane of life situations to show you right from wrong , good from bad, friend from foe.
wrong.translationZh: 即便在最平凡的生活场景中，它也一直都在，指引我们明辨是非、区分善恶、识别敌友。
wrong.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

wave.sentenceEn: The Nagpur project has already created a risk and vulnerability map, which enabled Kotharkar to tell officials which neighborhoods to focus on in the event of a heat wave this summer.
wave.translationZh: 那格浦尔项目已绘制出风险与脆弱性地图，这使科萨尔卡尔能够告知官员们，今年夏季发生热浪时应重点关注哪些社区。
wave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

wave.sentenceEn: That day's high temperature of roughly 36°C was 1°C shy of the heat wave alert threshold for coastal cities set by national meteorological authorities.
wave.translationZh: 当日最高气温约为36°C，比国家气象部门为沿海城市设定的热浪预警阈值低1°C。
wave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

wave.sentenceEn: The study is part of a new wave of thinking about adolescence.
wave.translationZh: 这项研究属于有关青春期的新一波思考浪潮。
wave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

wave.sentenceEn: The responsibility for the latest wave of strikes rests on the unions.
wave.translationZh: 最近一波罢工的责任在于工会。
wave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

wave.sentenceEn: Microsoft's own Office dominates the market for "productivity" software, but the start-ups represented a new wave of technology designed from the ground up for the smartphone world.
wave.translationZh: 微软自家的Office软件主导着"生产力"软件市场，但这些初创公司代表了为智能手机世界从头打造的新一轮技术浪潮。
wave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

wave.sentenceEn: There are upsetting parallels today, as scientists in one wave after another try to awaken us to the growing threat of global warming.
wave.translationZh: 如今，令人不安的相似情景再次上演：科学家们正前赴后继地试图唤醒我们，正视全球变暖带来的日益严重的威胁。
wave.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
wave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

warning.sentenceEn: For example, neighborhoods with a large elderly population or informal dwellings that cope poorly with heat could get special warnings or be bolstered with cooling centers.
warning.translationZh: 例如，老年人口众多的社区或难以应对高温的非正式住房区，可以获得特殊预警或增设降温中心。
warning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

warning.sentenceEn: In general, an HAP spells out when and how officials should issue heat warnings and alert hospitals and other institutions.
warning.translationZh: 一般而言，高温行动计划(HAP)规定了官员应何时以及如何发布高温预警，并向医院和其他机构发出警报。
warning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

warning.sentenceEn: Mumbai's April heatstroke deaths highlighted the need for more nuanced and localized warnings , researchers say.
warning.translationZh: 研究人员表示，孟买4月的中暑死亡事件凸显了对更细致、更本地化预警的需求。
warning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

warning.sentenceEn: France's planned tax is a clear warning : Unless a broad consensus can be reached on reforming the international tax system, other nations are likely to follow suit, and American companies will face a cascade of different taxes from dozens of nations that will prove burdensome and costly.
warning.translationZh: 法国拟议的这项税收是一个明确的警告：除非各国能就国际税收体系改革达成广泛共识，否则其他国家很可能会纷纷效仿，而美国企业将面临数十个国家征收的一系列不同税收，这将被证明是既繁重又代价高昂的。
warning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

warning.sentenceEn: The Food Standards Authority (FSA) has issued a public warning about the risks of a compound called acrylamide that forms in some foods cooked at high temperatures.
warning.translationZh: 英国食品标准局(FSA)已就一种名为丙烯酰胺的化合物风险发出公开警告，该化合物会在一些高温烹制的食物中形成。
warning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

warning.sentenceEn: cigarette-style warnings should be introduced to children about the dangers of a poor diet.
warning.translationZh: 应当向儿童推出类似香烟警示的饮食健康警告，告知他们不良饮食的危害。

working.sentenceEn: This perspective makes sense if you simplify the workings of a complex brain, reducing it to an array of electrical pulses; cells in plants also communicate through electrical signals.
working.translationZh: 如果你将复杂大脑的运作机制简化为一系列电脉冲，那么这种观点确实有一定道理；植物细胞也通过电信号进行交流。
working.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

working.sentenceEn: It has been estimated that this generation, due to the pressures of technology, the wish for personal fulfilment and desire for diversity, will work for 17 different employers over the course of their working life and have five different careers.
working.translationZh: 据估计，由于技术发展的压力、对个人成就感的追求以及对多元化的渴望，这一代人在其职业生涯中将为17个不同的雇主工作，并从事5种不同的职业。
working.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

working.sentenceEn: In other words, at a time when the working class has turned the country on its political head, frustrated that the opportunity that once defined America is vanishing, one obvious solution is staring us in the face.
working.translationZh: 换言之，在工人阶级已使国家政治格局发生彻底改变的当下——他们因曾经定义美国的机会正在消失而感到沮丧——一个显而易见的解决方案就在我们眼前。
working.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

working.sentenceEn: The family's increasing poverty forced Dickens out of school at age 12 to work in Warren's Blacking Warehouse, a shoe-polish factory, where the other working boys mocked him as "the young gentleman."
working.translationZh: 家庭日益加剧的贫困迫使狄更斯在12岁时辍学，进入沃伦黑鞋油厂工作。在这家鞋油厂里，其他童工都嘲笑他是"小绅士"。

working.sentenceEn: One Gallup poll found that 20 percent of Americans who have been unemployed for at least a year report having depression, double the rate for working Americans.
working.translationZh: 盖洛普的一项民意调查发现，失业至少一年的美国人中有20%报告患有抑郁症，这一比例是在职美国人的两倍。
working.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

working.sentenceEn: With the blurring of roles, and the fact that the home front lags well behind the workplace in making adjustments for working women, it's not surprising that women are more stressed at home.
working.translationZh: 由于角色界限变得模糊，再加上家庭领域在为职业女性做出调整方面远远落后于工作场所，女性在家中压力更大也就不足为奇了。
working.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

wage.sentenceEn: So, to increase employee wages without raising prices, more employers are succumbing to the temptations of tip creep and tipflation.
wage.translationZh: 因此，为了在不提高价格的情况下增加员工工资，越来越多的雇主正屈服于小费蔓延和小费膨胀的诱惑。
wage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

wage.sentenceEn: To ensure that all employees were paid fair wages , some restaurants banned tipping and increased prices, but this movement toward no-tipping services has largely fizzled out.
wage.translationZh: 为确保所有员工都能获得公平工资，一些餐厅曾禁止小费并提高价格，但这种无小费服务的趋势在很大程度上已经消退。
wage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

wage.sentenceEn: Tipping has always been a vital source of income for workers in historically tipped services, like restaurants, where the tipped minimum wage can be as low as US$2.13 an hour.
wage.translationZh: 小费一直是传统小费服务行业工作者的重要收入来源，例如餐厅，这些行业的小费最低工资标准可低至每小时2.13美元。
wage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

wage.sentenceEn: U.S. customers historically tipped people they assumed were earning most of their income via tips, such as restaurant servers earning less than the minimum wage .
wage.translationZh: 美国顾客历来会给那些他们认为主要靠小费收入的人小费，比如收入低于最低工资的餐厅服务员。
wage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

wage.sentenceEn: If not placing jobs at risk, to the extent employment protection laws constrain business owners from dismissing under-performing managers, those laws act as a constraint on firm productivity and therefore on workers' wages .
wage.translationZh: 即便没有将工作置于风险之中，就业保护法只要在一定程度上限制企业主解雇表现不佳的管理人员，就会对企业生产力构成制约，进而影响工人工资。
wage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

wage.sentenceEn: Then I counter with another reasonable argument: that a higher minimum wage will force businesses to employ fewer people for less time.
wage.translationZh: 那么我会用另一个合理的论点反驳：提高最低工资会迫使企业减少雇佣人数、缩短雇佣时间。

workplace.sentenceEn: If you have a bone to pick with someone in your workplace , you may try to stay tight-lipped around them.
workplace.translationZh: 如果你在工作中与某人有矛盾，你可能会在他们面前选择缄口不言。
workplace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

workplace.sentenceEn: The difference between today's workplace and the "dress for success" era is that the range of options is so much broader.
workplace.translationZh: 如今的职场与“为成功而着装”时代的不同之处在于，着装选择的范围要广泛得多。
workplace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

workplace.sentenceEn: With the blurring of roles, and the fact that the home front lags well behind the workplace in making adjustments for working women, it's not surprising that women are more stressed at home.
workplace.translationZh: 由于角色界限变得模糊，再加上家庭领域在为职业女性做出调整方面远远落后于工作场所，女性在家中压力更大也就不足为奇了。
workplace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

workplace.sentenceEn: In a workplace that's fundamentally indifferent to your life and its meaning, office speak can help you figure out how you relate to your work – and how your work defines who you are.
workplace.translationZh: 在一个根本上对你的生活及其意义漠不关心的工作环境中，办公室用语可以帮助你弄清楚自己与工作的关系——以及工作如何定义你是谁。
workplace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

workplace.sentenceEn: In our rapidly changing economy, we more than ever need people in the workplace who can take initiative and exercise their imagination "to respond to unexpected events".
workplace.translationZh: 在我们瞬息万变的经济环境中，我们比以往任何时候都更需要那些在工作场合能够主动采取行动并发挥想象力以应对突发事件的人才。
workplace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

workplace.sentenceEn: New ways of organizing workplaces may help to increase productivity.
workplace.translationZh: 新型的工作场所组织方式可能有助于提高生产力。
workplace.paperLabel: 考研英语 1998 英语（未分卷）

widespread.sentenceEn: Although these efforts were aimed at the nonscience-bound student, they never really made their way into mainstream thought and public discourse as a means to rally widespread support for the importance of science teaching in schools.
widespread.translationZh: 尽管这些努力旨在针对非科学专业的学生，但它们从未真正进入主流思想和公共舆论，未能成为一种在学校中争取广泛支持科学教育重要性的手段。
widespread.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

widespread.sentenceEn: Psychologists have been interested in this question for decades, not least because people's widespread reluctance to ask for help has led to some high-profile failures.
widespread.translationZh: 心理学家对这个问题的研究已有数十年之久，尤其是因为人们普遍不愿寻求帮助，这已导致了一些备受瞩目的失败案例。
widespread.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

widespread.sentenceEn: It's just that individual actions are too slow, she says, for that to be the only, or even primary, approach to changing widespread behavior.
widespread.translationZh: 她表示，只是个人行动见效太慢，不足以成为改变普遍行为的唯一甚至主要途径。
widespread.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

widespread.sentenceEn: Court, school, organizations of amateurs, and the traveling actors were all rivals in supplying a widespread desire for dramatic entertainment; and no boy who went to a grammar school could be ignorant that the drama was a form of literature which gave glory to Greece and Rome and might yet bring honor to England.
widespread.translationZh: 宫廷、学校、业余剧团以及巡回演员都竞相满足人们对戏剧娱乐的广泛需求；任何上过文法学校的男孩都不会不知道，戏剧是一种曾为希腊和罗马带来荣耀的文学形式，或许也能为英格兰带来荣誉。
widespread.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

widespread.sentenceEn: Today, widespread social pressure to immediately go to college in conjunction with increasingly high expectations in a fast-moving world often causes students to completely overlook the possibility of taking a gap year.
widespread.translationZh: 如今，要求学生立即上大学的普遍社会压力，加之在这个瞬息万变的世界中日益增高的期望，往往导致学生们完全忽视了间隔年的可能性。
widespread.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

widespread.sentenceEn: This same absence of moral purpose was wounding companies such as News International, she thought, making it more likely that it would lose its way as it had with widespread illegal telephone hacking.
widespread.translationZh: 她认为，这种道德目标的缺失正损害着像新闻国际这样的公司，使其更有可能迷失方向，就像其在大规模非法电话窃听事件中那样。
widespread.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

wild.sentenceEn: The team reconstructed the animals' evolutionary tree and used computer models to pinpoint the domestication event when herders in Kenya and the Horn of Africa tamed wild asses.
wild.translationZh: 研究团队重建了这些动物的进化树，并利用计算机模型精准定位了这次驯化事件，即肯尼亚和非洲之角的牧民驯服野驴的时间点。
wild.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

wild.sentenceEn: They also looked at genomes from 15 wild equids and 31 earlier donkeys that lived between about 4,000 and 100 years ago.
wild.translationZh: 他们还研究了来自 15 种野生马科动物以及 31 头生活在大约 4,000 年至 100 年前的早期驴类的基因组。
wild.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

wild.sentenceEn: Unlike some photographers, who "cheat" by keeping insects in a fridge to slow them down, Peters refuses to tamper with wild butterflies.
wild.translationZh: 有些摄影师会把昆虫放进冰箱使其行动迟缓来"作弊"，而彼得斯则拒绝以这种方式干扰野生蝴蝶。

wild.sentenceEn: So what's the appeal of a long, sweaty day in pursuit of an elusive, fast-moving wild animal?
wild.translationZh: 那么，花上漫长而汗流浃背的一天，去追逐一只难以捉摸、行动迅速的野生动物，究竟有什么吸引力呢？

wild.sentenceEn: Butterflies may not pollinate as many plants as wild bees and hoverflies, but because British butterflies are the best-studied group of insects in the world, they are an extremely useful indicator of the wider declines in flying insects.
wild.translationZh: 蝴蝶可能不像野生蜜蜂和食蚜蝇那样为那么多植物授粉，但由于英国蝴蝶是世界上研究最深入的昆虫群体，它们是反映飞行昆虫广泛减少的极其有用的指标。

wild.sentenceEn: For wild animals that cannot be returned to their natural habitats, zoos offer the best alternative.
wild.translationZh: 对于无法回归自然栖息地的野生动物而言，动物园提供了最佳的替代选择。

wildlife.sentenceEn: We can offer them a visit to Blackwater National Wildlife Refuge in Dorchester County where bald eagles fly over tidal marshes so shallow you could not paddle a boat across them, but teeming with aquatic life.
wildlife.translationZh: 我们建议他们参观多切斯特县的黑水国家野生动物保护区，在那里，白头海雕翱翔于潮汐沼泽上空。这些沼泽水浅得连小船都无法划行，却孕育着丰富的水生生物。
wildlife.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

wildlife.sentenceEn: Ed Home, of the RHS, said: "We launched our sustainability strategy last year and fake grass is just not in line with our ethos and views on plastic. We recommend using real grass because of its environmental benefits, which include supporting wildlife , alleviating flooding and cooling the environment."
wildlife.translationZh: 英国皇家园艺学会的埃德·霍姆表示：“我们去年启动了可持续发展战略，而人造草坪不符合我们的理念以及对塑料的立场。我们建议使用天然草坪，因为它具有诸多环境益处，包括支持野生动物生存、缓解洪涝灾害以及降低环境温度。”
wildlife.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

wildlife.sentenceEn: I was a zoo and wildlife park employee for years.
wildlife.translationZh: 我曾在动物园和野生动物园工作多年。
wildlife.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

wildlife.sentenceEn: These are mostly students who had no opportunity as children to travel to wilderness areas, wildlife refuges or national parks.
wildlife.translationZh: 这些学生大多在儿时没有机会前往荒野地区、野生动物保护区或国家公园。
wildlife.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

wildlife.sentenceEn: Both the wildlife park and zoo claimed to be operating for the benefit of the animals and for conservation purposes.
wildlife.translationZh: 野生动物园和动物园都声称其运营是为了动物的利益和保护目的。
wildlife.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

wildlife.sentenceEn: Zoos save people trips to wilderness areas and thus contribute to wildlife conservation.
wildlife.translationZh: 动物园让人们无需前往荒野地区，从而为野生动物保护做出贡献。

weakness.sentenceEn: In other words you're broadcasting your own weaknesses , which can be uncomfortable.
weakness.translationZh: 换句话说，你在暴露自己的弱点，这可能会让人感到不舒服。
weakness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

weakness.sentenceEn: Among other weaknesses , the measures cities must employ when left to tackle dirty air on their own are politically controversial, and therefore vulnerable.
weakness.translationZh: 在诸多缺陷中，当城市被迫独自应对空气污染问题时所必须采取的措施具有政治争议性，因此很容易被推翻。
weakness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

weakness.sentenceEn: Humility requires you to recognize weakness in your own arguments and sometimes also to accept reasons on the opposite side.
weakness.translationZh: 谦逊要求我们认识到自己论点中的不足，有时也需要接受对方的合理观点。

weakness.sentenceEn: Vaux says that Science's idea to pass some papers to statisticians "has some merit, but a weakness is that it relies on the board of reviewing editors to identify 'the papers that need scrutiny' in the first place".
weakness.translationZh: 沃克斯表示，《科学》杂志将部分论文交由统计学家审核的想法“有一定价值，但缺点在于它首先依赖审稿编辑委员会来识别‘需要仔细审查的论文’”。
weakness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

weakness.sentenceEn: Which is considered a weakness of the city-level measures to tackle dirty air?
weakness.translationZh: 城市层面解决空气污染的措施被认为存在什么缺点？

weakness.sentenceEn: It is worrisome that society is medicalizing more and more behavioral problems, often defining as addictions what earlier, sterner generations explained as weakness of will.
weakness.translationZh: 令人担忧的是，社会正将越来越多的行为问题医学化，常常把过去更为严格的几代人解释为意志力薄弱的问题定义为成瘾。
weakness.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）

wildfire.sentenceEn: In the study, the researchers compared the historical fire cadence with the wildfires recorded over the past few decades, and uncovered a striking shortfall.
wildfire.translationZh: 研究人员在研究中将历史火灾频率与过去几十年记录的野火进行了对比，发现两者之间存在显著差距。
wildfire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

wildfire.sentenceEn: "It's a double-edged sword because wildfires are getting more severe and larger under climate change and we need this work even more, but then the work gets more challenging," said Susan Prichard, a fire ecologist at the University of Washington.
wildfire.translationZh: 华盛顿大学的火灾生态学家苏珊·普里查德表示：“这是一把双刃剑，因为在气候变化的影响下，野火正变得愈发严重且规模更大，我们比以往任何时候都更需要这项工作，但与此同时，工作的开展也变得更具挑战性。”
wildfire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

wildfire.sentenceEn: Research shows that these prescribed burns make subsequent wildfires less severe, even if later fires happen under the most dangerous weather conditions.
wildfire.translationZh: 研究表明，这种计划烧除可以降低后续野火的严重程度，即使火灾发生在最危险的天气条件下也是如此。
wildfire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

wildfire.sentenceEn: Already, since 2010, drought and insects have killed over 100 million trees in California, most of them in 2016 alone, and wildfires have burned hundreds of thousands of acres.
wildfire.translationZh: 自2010年以来，干旱和虫害已导致加利福尼亚州超过1亿棵树木死亡，其中大部分仅在2016年一年就死亡了，同时野火烧毁了数十万英亩的森林。
wildfire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

wildfire.sentenceEn: What did the study find about the wildfires over the past few decades?
wildfire.translationZh: 这项研究对过去几十年的山火有哪些发现？

wildfire.sentenceEn: it is challenging to predict large wildfires .
wildfire.translationZh: 预测大规模山火是一项挑战。

witness.sentenceEn: Stand in the shoes of scientists and witness the degree to which breakthroughs emerge from accidents, conflict and sheer mental stamina.
witness.translationZh: 身临其境地体验科学家的生活，见证重大突破是如何在偶然、冲突以及非凡的意志力中诞生的。

witness.sentenceEn: By the date of his birth Europe was witnessing the passing of the religious drama, and the creation of new forms under the incentive of classical tragedy and comedy.
witness.translationZh: 在莎士比亚出生之际，欧洲正见证着宗教戏剧的衰落，以及在古典悲剧与喜剧的启发下新戏剧形式的诞生。
witness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

witness.sentenceEn: Concerns were raised that witnesses might be encouraged to exaggerate their stories in court to ensure guilty verdicts.
witness.translationZh: 人们担心，证人可能会被怂恿在法庭上夸大其词，以确保获得有罪判决。
witness.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
witness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

witness.sentenceEn: In a significant tightening of legal controls over the press, Lord Irvine, the Lord Chancellor, will introduce a draft bill that will propose making payments to witnesses illegal and will strictly control the amount of publicity that can be given to a case before a trial begins.
witness.translationZh: 为显著加强对新闻媒体的法律监管，大法官欧文勋爵将提出一项草案，该草案将提议把向证人付费定为非法行为，并将严格控制案件在开庭审理前的公开程度。
witness.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
witness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

witness.sentenceEn: Witness payments became an issue after West was sentenced to 10 life sentences in 1995.
witness.translationZh: 1995年韦斯特被判处10次终身监禁后，向证人付费的做法成为了一个争议问题。
witness.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
witness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

witness.sentenceEn: Up to 19 witnesses were said to have received payments for telling their stories to newspapers.
witness.translationZh: 据称，多达19名证人因向报社讲述其经历而获得报酬。
witness.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
witness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

weaken.sentenceEn: High growth rates increased the chances for academic innovation; they also weakened the forms and processes by which teachers and students are admitted into a community of scholars during periods of stability or slow growth.
weaken.translationZh: 高增长率增加了学术创新的机会；但同时也削弱了在稳定或缓慢增长时期教师和学生融入学术共同体的形式与流程。
weaken.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

weaken.sentenceEn: It is like the immune system of the body, which under stress or through lack of nutrition or exercise can be weakened , but which never leaves us.
weaken.translationZh: 它就像人体的免疫系统，在压力下或因缺乏营养、缺少锻炼而可能被削弱，但它永远不会离开我们。
weaken.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

weaken.sentenceEn: Yet, in several instances, justices acted in ways that weakened the court's reputation for being independent and impartial.
weaken.translationZh: 然而，在若干情况下，大法官的行事方式损害了最高法院独立公正的声誉。
weaken.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

weaken.sentenceEn: Last year Mitsuo Setoyama, who was then education minister, raised eyebrows when he argued that liberal reforms introduced by the American occupation authorities after World War II had weakened the "Japanese morality of respect for parents."
weaken.translationZh: 去年，时任文部大臣的濑户光夫提出，二战后美国占领当局推行的自由改革削弱了"尊敬父母的日本道德观"，这一言论引起轩然大波。
weaken.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
weaken.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

weaken.sentenceEn: Urban Japanese have long endured lengthy commutes (travels to and from work) and crowded living conditions, but as the old group and family values weaken , the discomfort is beginning to tell.
weaken.translationZh: 城市里的日本人长期以来一直忍受着漫长的通勤（上下班往返路程）和拥挤的居住环境，但随着传统群体观念和家庭价值观的弱化，这种不适感开始显现出来。
weaken.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
weaken.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

wellbeing.sentenceEn: Chaudhary said that parents now had less childcare support from family and social networks than during most of humans' evolutionary history, but introducing additional caregivers could reduce stress and maternal depression, which could have a "knock-on" benefit to a child's wellbeing .
wellbeing.translationZh: 乔杜里指出，与人类进化史的大部分时期相比，如今的父母从家庭和社交网络获得的育儿支持更少。但增加额外的照料者可以减轻压力和母亲抑郁，这可能对孩子的福祉产生'连锁'益处。
wellbeing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

wellbeing.sentenceEn: Teri Byrd: Zoos should have been closed down as they prioritize money making over animals' wellbeing .
wellbeing.translationZh: 特里·伯德：动物园早就该关闭了，因为它们把赚钱看得比动物的福祉更重要。
wellbeing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

wellbeing.sentenceEn: When you remember such things you can automatically become an investor in their wellbeing .
wellbeing.translationZh: 当你记住这些细节时，你自然而然就成为了关心他们福祉的人。
wellbeing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第18段，第1句

wellbeing.sentenceEn: Instead, being grateful for small things every day is a much better way to improve wellbeing .
wellbeing.translationZh: 相反，每天对小事心怀感恩才是提升幸福感的更佳方式。
wellbeing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

wellbeing.sentenceEn: Instead, they look after their wellbeing instinctively, and usually more effectively than we do as grownups.
wellbeing.translationZh: 相反，他们本能地照顾自己的幸福感，而且通常比我们成年人做得更有效。
wellbeing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

wellbeing.sentenceEn: Zoos should have been closed down as they prioritize money making over animals' wellbeing .
wellbeing.translationZh: 动物园早就该关闭了，因为它们把赚钱置于动物福祉之上。

warming.sentenceEn: Over the past decade, the focus has been on climate change – how the warming of the Earth from greenhouse gases is leading to conditions that worsen fires.
warming.translationZh: 在过去十年中，关注点一直集中在气候变化上——即温室气体导致的地球变暖如何引发加剧火灾的环境条件。
warming.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

warming.sentenceEn: There are upsetting parallels today, as scientists in one wave after another try to awaken us to the growing threat of global warming .
warming.translationZh: 如今，令人不安的相似情景再次上演：科学家们正前赴后继地试图唤醒我们，正视全球变暖带来的日益严重的威胁。
warming.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
warming.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

warming.sentenceEn: But it's obvious that a majority of the president's advisers still don't take global warming seriously.
warming.translationZh: 但显然，总统的大多数顾问仍然没有认真对待全球变暖问题。
warming.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
warming.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

warming.sentenceEn: Just as on smoking, voices now come from many quarters insisting that the science about global warming is incomplete, that it's OK to keep pouring fumes into the air until we know for sure.
warming.translationZh: 与吸烟问题如出一辙，如今也有来自四面八方的声音坚称，关于全球变暖的科学研究尚不完善，在我们有确切结论之前，继续向空气中排放废气并无不可。
warming.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
warming.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

warming.sentenceEn: The true enemies of science, argues Paul Ehrlich of Stanford University, a pioneer of environmental studies, are those who question the evidence supporting global warming , the depletion of the ozone layer and other consequences of industrial growth.
warming.translationZh: 环境研究的先驱、斯坦福大学的保罗·埃利希认为，科学真正的敌人是那些质疑以下证据的人：支持全球变暖、臭氧层损耗以及工业发展带来的其他后果的证据。
warming.paperLabel: 考研英语 1998 英语（未分卷）
warming.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

warming.sentenceEn: According to the author, what should the Administration do about global warming ?
warming.translationZh: 根据作者的观点，政府应该如何应对全球变暖？
warming.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）

wealthy.sentenceEn: Sir John Reith said that it would end "isolation of the spirit" and rejoiced: "It does not matter how many thousands may be listening, there is always enough for others…the genius and the fool, the wealthy and the poor listen simultaneously."
wealthy.translationZh: 约翰·里思爵士曾表示，这将终结“精神上的孤立”，并欣喜地说道：“无论成千上万的人如何倾听，总是能惠及他人……天才与愚夫、富人与穷人都在同一时刻倾听。”
wealthy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

wealthy.sentenceEn: Rather officials must avoid double standards, or different types of access for average people and the wealthy .
wealthy.translationZh: 相反，官员必须避免双重标准，即不能给予普通民众和富人不同的接触机会。
wealthy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

wealthy.sentenceEn: Some imagine that the coming work-free world will be defined by inequality: A few wealthy people will own all the capital, and the masses will struggle in an impoverished wasteland.
wealthy.translationZh: 一些人想象，即将到来的无工作世界将以不平等为特征：少数富人将拥有所有资本，而大众将在贫困的荒原上挣扎。
wealthy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

wealthy.sentenceEn: Even so, these are wealthy families who party with the international 1%, and media intrusiveness makes it increasingly difficult to maintain the right image.
wealthy.translationZh: 即便如此，这些王室家族依旧财力雄厚，常与全球顶尖的1%富豪阶层社交聚会，而媒体的过度曝光也让他们越来越难以维持恰当的公众形象。
wealthy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

wealthy.sentenceEn: At a time when Thomas Piketty and other economists are warning of rising inequality and the increasing power of inherited wealth, it is bizarre that wealthy aristocratic families should still be the symbolic heart of modern democratic states.
wealthy.translationZh: 当托马斯·皮凯蒂及其他经济学家纷纷就日益加剧的不平等现象和继承财富不断膨胀的影响力发出警告之际，富有的贵族家族竟然仍是现代民主国家的象征性核心，这着实令人匪夷所思。
wealthy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

wealthy.sentenceEn: Wealthy people tend to have fewer children than poor people.
wealthy.translationZh: 富人往往比穷人孩子少。
wealthy.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）

wholesale.sentenceEn: Closer inspection reveals important differences among the biggest national markets, especially in their customer segments and wholesale structures, as well as the competitive dynamics of individual food and drink categories.
wholesale.translationZh: 然而，仔细观察会发现欧洲主要国家市场之间存在显著差异，特别是在客户细分、批发结构以及各类食品饮料的竞争动态方面。

wholesale.sentenceEn: This development is boosting wholesale demand from the food service segment by 4 to 5 percent a year across Europe, compared with growth in retail demand of 1 to 2 percent.
wholesale.translationZh: 这一发展使得整个欧洲餐饮服务领域的批发需求以每年4%至5%的速度增长，相比之下，零售需求的增长率仅为1%至2%。

wholesale.sentenceEn: For example, wholesale food and drink sales came to $268 billion in France, Germany, Italy, Spain, and the United Kingdom in 2000 – more than 40 percent of retail sales.
wholesale.translationZh: 例如，2000年法国、德国、意大利、西班牙和英国的食品饮料批发销售额达到2680亿美元，超过零售销售额的40%。

wholesale.sentenceEn: Overall, Europe's wholesale market for food and drink is growing at the same sluggish pace as the retail market, but the figures, when added together, mask two opposing trends.
wholesale.translationZh: 总体而言，欧洲食品饮料批发市场的增长速度与零售市场一样缓慢，但将这些数据汇总后，却掩盖了两种相反的趋势。

wholesale.sentenceEn: But almost all have ignored the big, profitable opportunity in their own backyard: the wholesale food and drink trade, which appears to be just the kind of market retailers need.
wholesale.translationZh: 但几乎所有零售商都忽视了自家后院这个巨大且利润丰厚的机会：食品饮料批发市场，这似乎正是零售商所需要的那种市场。

wholesale.sentenceEn: Despite variations in detail, wholesale markets in the countries that have been closely examined—France, Germany, Italy and Spain—are made out of the same building blocks.
wholesale.translationZh: 尽管在细节上存在差异，但经过仔细研究的国家——法国、德国、意大利和西班牙——的批发市场结构基本相同。

worm.sentenceEn: "I'm excited about our progress," says Brown, who harvests eggs for Denver-based Nest Fresh Eggs and is adding more cover crops that draw worms and crickets for the chickens to eat.
worm.translationZh: 拉里·布朗为总部位于丹佛的Nest Fresh Eggs公司供应鸡蛋，他表示：“我对我们的进展感到兴奋。”目前，他正在种植更多覆盖作物，以吸引蠕虫和蟋蟀供鸡食用。
worm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

worm.sentenceEn: Dr. Worm acknowledges that these figures are conservative.
worm.translationZh: 沃尔姆博士承认，这些数据还是保守估计。
worm.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
worm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

worm.sentenceEn: What researchers such as Ransom Myers and Boris Worm have shown is just how fast things are changing.
worm.translationZh: 而像兰塞姆·迈尔斯和鲍里斯·沃尔姆这样的研究人员所揭示的，正是情况变化的速度有多快。
worm.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
worm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

worm.sentenceEn: Dr. Myers and Dr. Worm argue that their work gives a correct baseline, which future management efforts must take into account.
worm.translationZh: 迈尔斯博士和沃尔姆博士认为，他们的研究提供了一个准确的基准，未来的管理工作必须将其纳入考量。
worm.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
worm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

worm.sentenceEn: In the West, before mass communication and literacy, the most powerful mass medium was the church, which reminded worshippers that their souls were in danger and that they would someday be meat for worms .
worm.translationZh: 在西方，在大众传播和识字率普及之前，最强大的大众媒介是教会，它提醒信徒们，他们的灵魂处于危险之中，他们有朝一日将成为蠕虫的食粮。
worm.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
worm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句
